brief: Declares a multi-agent composition as a colored graph and proves it sound before anything runs.
detail: Actors (program, language model, hybrid), guardians, effects, tools, trace sinks, inputs and human checkpoints are nodes, each with a fixed capability set and a taint color; edges say who proposes to, guards, feeds, traces or escalates to whom. The invariants checked are: a language-model actor never holds the effectful capability, every effect has a guardian into it and a path to a trace sink, open model text and external data never reach an effect without a guardian on the path. Grant is the governed door, which refuses effectful for an llm actor at the moment it is expressed, and a sealed record of what the doors granted lets Tampering report any property set around them through GraphQ. Declaring an id again replaces the node.
